flashdb.description: Competition scoring source pin requested for FlashDB runs. Existing historical evidence may reference older commits, but new competition-targeted extraction must validate this repository, branch, and commit before generating slice specs.

cargo_mirror_activation.description: env.sh exports CARGO_HOME to the profile-local cargo directory so Cargo uses the Huawei crates.io sparse mirror without mutating the user's global Cargo home.

local_distribution.description: clang can be placed as a vendored binary inside the project directory so the competition host does not need a system-wide LLVM installation.
local_distribution.usage: Drop a compatible clang binary into one of the search_paths above. auto_migrate.py and the clang frontend will prefer CLANG_PATH env var when set, then fall back to these local paths.

local_fallback.description: When CLANG_PATH is not set in the environment, the competition clang lane falls back to project-local vendored clang binaries before reporting missing_clang_path.

clang_validation.description: When a clang binary is available through CLANG_PATH or a project-local vendored path, the shell self-check should prove the binary can locate its resource-dir and parse a minimal TU using standard integer/size headers before the competition clang lane is treated as available.

applies_to.clang_policy: clang is not required for default paths. The competition clang lane is opt-in. clang may be provided as a vendored local binary under tools/llvm/bin/ or tools/clang/bin/; this is not a system dependency and does not violate the no-default-clang rule.

adaptation_policy: Do not require Go for build, test, validation, or migration gates.
Do not require CMake in default competition gates; use Cargo, Python, gcc/g++, and GNU Make paths.
Keep Rust code compatible with stable Rust 1.96.0 and avoid nightly-only features.
Use Python 3.12-compatible scripts and avoid dependencies that require a newer Python runtime.
Use Node/npm scripts compatible with Node v24.13.0 and npm 11.6.2.
Use the configured Huawei mirrors for package-manager access in competition jobs.
Record this profile id and environment.json hash in generated validation evidence when a run is performed in the competition environment.

Clang is not required for default gates. The typed-IR clang lane is opt-in. Clang may be vendored locally under tools/llvm/bin/ or tools/clang/bin/ and used via the competition clang lane; this is not a system-level dependency.
LIBCLANG_PATH is explicitly ignored for AST dump JSON; only CLANG_PATH or a vendored clang binary path is accepted for the competition clang lane.
The env.sh script auto-detects vendored clang from repository-root tools paths and exports CLANG_PATH when CLANG_PATH is not already set.
The env.sh script exports CARGO_HOME=config/competition-env/cargo so Cargo uses the Huawei sparse registry profile without mutating the user's global Cargo configuration.
